Pitwall is a desktop terminal application designed for managing multiple AI coding agents simultaneously. It provides a visual overview of each agent's status, highlights tasks requiring attention, and allows for quick navigation and interaction with agents directly from the interface or a paired mobile device.

Zeroshot is a Rust-based tool that orchestrates AI coding agents in a graph-based workflow. It separates code implementation from review and repair, ensuring that code is only shipped after independent agents have verified its quality. It supports various AI models like Codex, Claude Code, and Copilot.
